name: Medical Simulator VR : Ultimate Edition
summary:
Medical Simulator VR: Ultimate Edition is an advanced Virtual Reality medical training solution specifically designed for healthcare professionals, residents, obstetricians, and midwifery or nursing students. Building upon standard procedural training, this edition expands into high-stakes clinical scenarios, allowing users to practice labor delivery, emergency complication management, and neonatal resuscitation within a safe, zero-risk virtual environment.
